stories.title: Braves 8-Game Win Streak + Olson Reaches 897 Consecutive Games — Acuña Hits Two

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Matt Olson's consecutive games streak is now 897.

He launched a 422-foot HR in the 6th, doubled, and walked twice. Braves 11-3.

The streak started May 2, 2021. He's 8th all-time in MLB history.

Atlanta has won 8 in a row — a season-high. #Braves

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Ronald Acuña Jr. hit his 10th and 11th home runs of 2026 on Thursday.

One of them bounced off a Marlins outfielder's glove and flew over the wall.

Braves 11-3. Eight straight wins. Matt Olson also homered (No. 32, 422 feet). #Braves
